name: CertStream (public best-effort instance)
tier_rationale: P030 cond 5: certstream.calidog.io is tier community, terms open (public CT data, MIT server); a public best-effort service with past outages, run by a small team (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Relays public Certificate Transparency log entries (append-only, verifiable in the logs themselves); the public instance is best-effort (outages, no backfill), which reads 'could not verify', never 'no certificates'.

stream.title: CertStream WebSocket firehose (certificate_update messages: leaf_cert.all_domains, serial, issuer, not_before; local filtering only)

terms.quote: certstream.calidog.io is tier community, terms open (public CT data, MIT server; evidence recorded per A1)

stream.notes: Quote: binding council text (P030 cond 5); research C0009 verified_live (HTTP 101 handshake, example.json 200): 'Public best-effort service by Calidog (certstream-server is MIT; can self-host certstream-server-go)'. Consumed only by `v3lum watch` (v3lum/core/watch.py, optional extra v3lum[watch]): the consumer sends nothing - org-profile keywords and permutations are matched locally. Upstream family ct-logs (crt.sh, Cert Spotter and CertStream mirror the same public CT logs).

notes: Owned by WP26 (watch mode, P030). Setting certstream_url points watch to a self-hosted certstream-server-go first (MIT, same message format; research C0756); such an endpoint is disclosure 'internal' when its host is in the organisation's network (private address, internal name, own domain/network of the org profile) and is decided at runtime by v3lum.core.watch.certstream_endpoint - it is not a host of this fragment. Direct RFC 6962 / static-ct-api log polling is deferred (BACKLOG).
